title: crataegus albicans var. tatnalliana
intro: Crataegus albicans var. tatnalliana, commonly known as Tatnall's hawthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, specifically a variety of the hawthorn tree native to North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing cardiovascular risk, lowering blood pressure, and improving lipid profiles, due to its ability to exhibit cardiotonic and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus albicans var. tatnalliana include acting as a vasodilator, reducing platelet aggregation, and improving endothelial function. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, such as quercetin, vitexin, and epicatechin.
